mission: Prove one defensive Gravity Fist semantic across the Vanguard adapter boundary: a live directional block denies a facing hit for its full block duration, while only a facing hit inside the early counter window transitions immediately into the donor counter and global offense lockout.

evidence: scripts/player.gd:10-14 defines 1.0 s block, 0.5 s counter window, Headbutt counter, and 3.0 s parry offense lockout
scripts/player.gd:428-435 dispatches a horizontal swipe directly to block when stomp and Superman Punch do not take authority
scripts/player.gd:713-745 rejects block-cancelling Headbutt, preserves the standard-chain index, cancels the prior state, faces the swipe direction, and enters Block
scripts/player.gd:1221-1232 consumes Headbutt, locks conductor offense, ends Block without locomotion, restores the chain index, and starts the counter
scripts/player.gd:1253-1267 requires active block and a facing attacker; <= counter window attempts the counter; every facing hit during Block returns blocked
scripts/player.gd:1296-1337 handles the block swipe immediately and defines no block-input buffer
scripts/player.gd:1479-1488 expires Block at block_duration while keeping movement stopped
scenes/ai_controller.gd:1155-1171 and 1628-1635 consume a blocked hit, deny damage, stun the attacker, revoke permission, reset its chain, and finish its attack
scenes/ai_conductor.gd:767-770 clears attack ownership and applies the parry-wide offense lockout
player_attacks.json:2-10 defines Headbutt with attack_end 0.66 s

semanticInvariant.name: directional-block-early-counter-upgrade
semanticInvariant.executable: A live directional block lasts 1000 ms. A hit from the faced side while Block is active is denied. If block elapsed is <=500 ms, the same hit ends Block immediately, restores the preserved standard-chain index, starts Headbutt once, stuns/interrupts the attacker, and locks global enemy offense for 3000 ms. If elapsed is >500 ms, the hit remains an ordinary block: no counter and no global parry lockout. A rear hit or a hit after Block expires is not denied.
semanticInvariant.inputRule: Block is invoked live by the recognized horizontal swipe; it is not queued. Headbutt cannot be cancelled into another block.
semanticInvariant.catalogPrecondition: The pinned donor catalog contains Headbutt. The proof does not generalize the donor fallback behavior when the named counter is absent.
excluded: input gesture recognition in the target

presentationFixture.role: Read-only target counter-presentation fixture; its 610 ms visual duration is not combat authority and no claim is made that it is a Headbutt.

targetBoundary.authorityRule: The adapter owns defensive state and hit resolution. Existing recipes, atlas pixels, runtime rendering, VFX, and feel remain separate locked presentation concerns.

requiredEvidence: all donor source and attack-catalog hashes match
a facing hit at exactly 500 ms blocks damage and starts exactly one counter
a facing hit at 501 ms blocks damage but starts no counter and applies no global parry lockout
a rear hit during Block and any hit after 1000 ms remain damage-authorized
the successful counter restores the chain index frozen at Block entry
a Block request during Headbutt is rejected and never appears later as a buffered block
shorter and longer counter-presentation durations do not alter the 660 ms counter semantic end

humanReview.reason: The proof is deterministic defensive state-transition parity only. Animation, VFX, readability, and feel remain unreviewed.
